main.default_content: 🦎 - This is my cool Container Builder message!

text_display.label: Text Display
text_display.description: › Text displays show formatted text - just like normal message content, but as a standalone component. At most {max} characters per text display.

container.label: Container
container.description: › Containers group several elements in a colored box. They can hold text displays, media galleries and separators - but no other container.
container.empty: › This container is still empty. Pick an element in the lower dropdown to add it.

media_gallery.label: Media Gallery
media_gallery.description: › Media galleries show up to {max} images or videos side by side, sorted within a grid.
media_gallery.empty: › This media gallery is still empty. Click "Edit Media Gallery" to add images or videos.

separator.label: Separator
separator.description: › Separators add spacing or a visible line between elements.

content.description: › Manage elements that sit directly in the message - outside of containers. Pick an element in the lower dropdown to add or edit it.

move.title: ↔️ ~ Move {kind}
move.description:
› Current location: **{location}**
Pick the target in the lower dropdown. The element is appended at its end.

order.title: 🔀 ~ Component order - {location}
order.description: › Pick an element in the lower dropdown and move it up or down with the arrow buttons.
order.description_empty: › There are no elements to arrange here yet.

templates.title: 📁 ~ Container Templates
templates.description: › Save the current draft of your components as a template or load an existing one using the dropdown menu below.

broken_components.one: `⚠️` ~ **`1` component damaged:** It could not be restored from the template and was skipped - Save the template again to clean it up.
broken_components.other: `⚠️` ~ **`{count}` components damaged:** They could not be restored from the template and were skipped - Save the template again to clean it up.

broken_links.one: `⚠️` ~ **`1` media link unreachable:** An image/video of this template can no longer be retrieved (e.g. an expired upload) and may not be displayed - The template was loaded anyway.
broken_links.other: `⚠️` ~ **`{count}` media links unreachable:** Some images/videos of this template can no longer be retrieved (e.g. expired uploads) and may not be displayed - The template was loaded anyway.

load.not_v2: `⚠️` ~ **No Components V2 Layout:** The message cannot be edited - its text was taken over as a copy.
load.truncated: `⚠️` ~ **Message Truncated:** The message has {original} components, the Container Builder supports at most {max} - only the first {kept} were taken over.

unsupported.one: `⚠️` ~ **`1` component unsupported:** It (e.g. a button or a file) was not taken over.
unsupported.other: `⚠️` ~ **`{count}` components unsupported:** They (e.g. buttons or files) were not taken over.

load.copy_only: The message therefore cannot be edited directly.

info.preview_too_large: › Preview unavailable here: together with the controls, this part ({amount} components) would exceed Discord's limit of 40. It is shown in full in the sent message.

errors.component_limit: › `❌` - **Limit Reached:** At most {limit} components can be used. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.nothing_to_send: › `❌` - **Nothing To Send:** There is nothing to send yet - add a component first. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.nothing_to_save: › `❌` - **Nothing To Save:** There is nothing to save yet - add a component first. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.total_text: › `❌` - **Text Too Long:** The total text of all text displays must not exceed {max} characters. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.move_target_gone: › `❌` - **Target Not Found:** The target no longer exists. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.gallery_max_items: › `❌` - **Gallery Full:** A media gallery can hold at most {max} items. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.load_nothing_usable: › `❌` - **Nothing To Take Over:** This message contains no text or components that could be taken over. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.load_no_supported: › `❌` - **Not Supported:** This message contains no components the Container Builder supports. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.thumbnail_needs_image: › `❌` - **Image Missing:** Description and spoiler only apply together with an image. Upload an image - or leave both empty to remove the thumbnail. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
errors.gallery_invalid_media: › `❌` - **Invalid File:** Please upload only valid images or videos. <:loveangry:784930958084276224>
